state.description: The situation/evidence the score is made over. Requests that exceed the prepared head's token budget are rejected (INPUT_TRUNCATED, DEC-05).

question.description: The ordinal question to score against the state.

levels.description: The ordered levels, least to most. Unique ids and unique descriptions are required; duplicates would collapse native criteria (DEC-05).

id.description: The caller's stable level id, returned unchanged in the output.
